_doc: Generated SFX recipes, written by scripts/sfx/generate.py (`recipes` step) from scripts/sfx/gen-prompts.json and the automatic picks; build.py and catalogue.py merge this into recipes.json. Sources are .cache/sfx/dl/gen/<name>_NN.wav (picked, trimmed TangoFlux takes). Do not edit by hand: change gen-prompts.json (an item's `recipe` holds the catalogue fields and build overrides) and re-run.

recipes.name: phone_vibrate_table
recipes.what: Phone vibrating on the wooden coffee table: two buzzes, rattling against the wood
recipes.ch: Ch1 phone hotspot (12 unread) and the notification before it

recipes.name: watch_buzz_wrist
recipes.what: Smartwatch haptic buzz on the wrist, close and muffled
recipes.ch: Every ui.watchBuzz (Ch1 TIME TO MOVE, Ch2 PAUSE?, Ch4 ROWING DETECTED / 3 hr 12 min, Ch5 last menu)
recipes.replaces: audio.buzz() (keep the HUD shake as the twin)
recipes.bus: not used: one weak take; keep the procedural buzz()

recipes.name: tv_crt_off
recipes.what: CRT television switched off: button click, thump, fading whine
recipes.ch: Ch1 TV hotspot: E turns it off and the key light dies
recipes.replaces: new (cut tv_race_bed at the same moment)

recipes.name: boot_step_wood
recipes.what: Walking-boot step on old floorboards: flat plastic clump, slight creak
recipes.ch: Ch1 flat and Ch4 workshop: the bad-leg step
recipes.replaces: footstep('concrete', rate 0.72) + thud in Player._steps when footsteps==='boot' indoors
recipes.bus: bus, volume 0.35, +-4% rate; alternate with step_wood for the good foot

recipes.name: boot_step_wet
recipes.what: Walking-boot step on wet asphalt: flat clump with a small splash
recipes.ch: Ch2 and Ch5 street: the bad-leg step outdoors

recipes.name: run_step_wet
recipes.what: Running-shoe step on a wet road, light splash
recipes.ch: Ch3 rhythm, rain weeks (Week 20 heavier: volume up, rate 0.92)
recipes.replaces: footstep('concrete') in the Ch3 rhythm (run_step stays for Week 9)

recipes.name: breath_run_loop
recipes.what: Runner's steady mouth breathing at cadence (loop)
recipes.ch: Ch3 run: under the steps, gain follows cadence; ragged after the crack (rate 1.1, more gain)

recipes.name: crack_pencil_lead
recipes.what: Tiny dry snap, like a pencil lead breaking inside a drawer

recipes.replaces: audio.snap() (keep the tone() whine); plays on fx through cut()
recipes.bus: fx, volume 0.5, lowpass 3 kHz for the 'inside a drawer' distance

recipes.name: fluoro_flicker

recipes.ch: Ch1 tube stutter every 6-9 s; Ch4 Day 5 flicker

recipes.bus: bus, volume 0.2, distance gain with the tube

recipes.name: club_pass_wet
recipes.what: Group of runners splashing past on a wet street at night, approach and fade
recipes.ch: Ch2 run club in the rain (Ch5 keeps club_pass)
recipes.replaces: the per-runner footstep() loop in ch2.js
recipes.bus: bus, volume 0.5; StereoPanner swept +Z to -Z over the pass

recipes.name: paint_lid_open

recipes.ch: Ch4 Day 8 mixer start (five tins), Ch5 Hugo's panel
recipes.bus: fx, volume 0.5 (peaky: up to 9 dB under target)

recipes.name: paint_stir_loop
